erasure.heading: Privacy & account erasure
erasure.description: You can request that your personal information be erased. Your profile will be anonymized, your login disabled, and your personal details removed — transaction, financial and legal records are retained only where required, exactly as described in our Privacy Policy and POPIA page.
erasure.warningBody: Once erased, your account can never be restored to active. Your name, avatar and contact details will be removed, and you will be signed out everywhere.
erasure.blockedTitle: We can't erase your account yet
erasure.blockedOutro: Please resolve these first, then try again.
erasure.successBody: You've been signed out. Thank you for using Unity.
erasure.successBodyCleanupPending: Your account is erased and disabled for marketplace use. You've been signed out. We're still finishing a few background cleanup steps — this needs no action from you.
erasure.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
